other_failure_modes.name: Inefficient loops causing execution timeout
other_failure_modes.description: The agent writes heavily nested loops over classes and folds for operations like target encoding, constructing new DataFrames and running groupby operations in the innermost loop. This is extremely slow and results in execution timeouts on large datasets.

other_failure_modes.name: Dead code
other_failure_modes.description: The agent defines complex code structures (such as an entire PyTorch neural network architecture) but never instantiates, trains, or uses them in the final pipeline.

summary: The agent performs extensive feature engineering and builds an ensemble of LightGBM and XGBoost models. However, it fails to respect the temporal nature of the dataset during splitting (FM05) and uses a naive unweighted ensemble (FM12). Critically, the target encoding implementation loops over all 39 classes for each fold and feature, instantiating DataFrames repeatedly, which is highly inefficient and directly causes the script to timeout.
